Convert a depth over an area to discharge

Source: R/wet_mm_to_m3s.R
wet_mm_to_m3s.Rd

m3/s = mm * area_m2 / 1000 / (days * 86400). The default days = 365 is the conversion fwapg uses for mean annual discharge. The water balance uses 365.25 for a year and wet_month_days() for months, so that monthly volumes sum to the annual one.

Usage

wet_mm_to_m3s(mm, area_m2, days = 365)

Arguments

mm

Depth over the period, mm.

area_m2

Contributing area, m^2.

days

Length of the period, days.

Value

Discharge, m^3/s.

Examples

wet_mm_to_m3s(500, 1e8)  # 500 mm/yr over 100 km2 is about 1.59 m3/s
#> [1] 1.58549
wet_mm_to_m3s(40, 1e8, days = wet_month_days()[7])  # 40 mm in July
#>      Jul 
#> 1.493429
